notes.title: March 17th Update Log of "Water Transformer"
notes.content:
Update Instructions:
1、Optimized the typesetting issue of English subtitles.
2、Fixed the problem that the player's username and clearance time were not correctly displayed in the clearance interface.
3、Fixed the problem that the data of the laser emitter was not correctly loaded in the Map Workshop.
4、Fixed the problem that clicking the screenshot button while running a map in the editing mode of the Map Workshop would trigger the ability to pass through walls.

In addition, regarding the issue of less-than-ideal optimization mentioned by some players, we are already working on improvements. Thank you all for your feedback and suggestions!

notes.title: Platformer game "Water：Transformer" is now available!
notes.content:
Dear players, Water: Transformer is finally here! 
Welcome to purchase and experience the game. 
If you have any questions, feel free to contact us via comments or Discord. 
Hope you enjoy playing, and thank you!

notes.title: On March 6th, early access begins!
notes.content:
Dear players, "Water：Transformer" is about to launch its early access on March 6th. Thank you for your attention and support!

Currently, the game is playable to a certain extent, but there are still many shortcomings. During the early access period, we look forward to having more communication with you. At the same time, we will keep optimizing the game and continuously release updates to better enhance the gaming experience.

If you're interested in the game, hurry up and add it to your wishlist. Also, you're welcome to try out the game demo.

Thank you all again for your support. See you on March 6th!
